title: REVIVE Ashwagandha KSM-66
descriptionHtml:
Revive Ashwagandha KSM-66

A clinically dosed daily ashwagandha supplement built for athletes, lifters, busy professionals, and active adults dealing with elevated stress, training-induced fatigue, or sleep disruption from running too high for too long. Particularly relevant for hard trainers whose recovery is being compromised by chronic cortisol elevation, and anyone wanting documented adaptogen support backed by real clinical data — not generic herbal capsules.

What separates this from the average ashwagandha product comes down to the specific extract used. Revive uses KSM-66® — the most clinically researched ashwagandha extract on the market, produced through a patented extraction process that preserves the full spectrum of root constituents at high concentration. KSM-66 has been the subject of multiple peer-reviewed human clinical trials demonstrating measurable reductions in cortisol, perceived stress, and stress-related food cravings, alongside documented improvements in endurance, strength, muscle size, recovery rate, memory, and cognitive function. That clinical pedigree is the difference between paying for an evidence-backed extract and paying for an unverified bulk-grade powder. The formulation also includes BioPerine® — a patented black pepper fruit extract that improves nutrient absorption, helping the body actually use what's in the capsule.

Revive manufactures all of its supplements in the United States in facilities certified to GMP standards, with rigorous third-party testing and transparent labelling across the range. Note: this is a wellness and recovery supplement, not a sports-tested product — competing tested-pool athletes should always check the most current ingredient panel against their governing body's banned-substance list before use, but for general adult use the brand's manufacturing pedigree and physician-formulated approach make it one of the more credible options in the adaptogen category.

  • KSM-66® ashwagandha extract — the most clinically researched ashwagandha on the market with documented benefits in human trials
  • Clinical ashwagandha benefits include reduced cortisol, improved strength and endurance, better recovery, and supported cognitive function
  • BioPerine® black pepper extract included to improve nutrient absorption from the formulation
  • Daily-use ashwagandha tablet built for cumulative benefit — works best after 4–8 weeks of consistent daily use
  • A credible answer for anyone searching ashwagandha Sri Lanka — clinical-grade extract from a US brand, far above generic herbal capsules

Pair it with a daily multivitamin or recovery supplement from our vitamins and supplements range to round out a complete daily wellness routine.

Take the recommended daily serving with water, ideally with a meal for best absorption. Use consistently for at least 4–8 weeks for cumulative benefit — adaptogen effects build over time, not in a single dose. Many users prefer evening dosing to support the natural cortisol downshift before sleep. Consult a healthcare professional before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking prescription medications, or have an existing medical condition (particularly thyroid conditions). Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
